entry.name: mc.apply~
entry.digest: Apply a Function to a Multichannel Signal
entry.description: The mc.apply~ object accepts a breakpoint function in the same format as line~ and applies it over the space of channels of a multi-channel signal. Each channel contains a sample of the function evenly divided in the X dimension. In addition, mc.apply~ can store up to 64 functions, edited by mc.function, which you can recall and continuously interpolate using a signal input.

arguments.name: channels
arguments.description: Sets the number of output channels in the multi-channel signal. The default value is 1.

messages.description: In middle inlet: A list of breakpoints informat (as output by theobject) defines a function forto apply across a space of output channels. The list should consist of alternating value, time pairs. The function is applied such that the beginning (at 0) maps to the first output channel and the end maps to the last output channel.

messages.description: Specifies the index of the stored function to output, where 0 represents the first function. A number with a fractional part will interpolate between functions, so 0.5 will be halfway between the first and second stored.
